provenance: Repository-authored synthetic C24 recovery negative cases; injected failures only, no real secret, key or credential material.

cases.description: Restore without operator-held recovery material must be refused before any target bytes are written
A mismatched recovery material must be refused and leave the isolated target absent
A tampered backup manifest must fail integrity verification before restore
A tampered committed blob must fail hash verification before restore
An incomplete backup must be refused instead of restoring a partial store
A tampered provider snapshot must be refused before the target store is created
Restoring an older backup over a non-empty target must be refused without overwriting newer accepted state
A copy failure mid-restore must leave no partial authoritative target and no usable staging directory
A durable manifest published without an acknowledgement must replay idempotently after restart
Exhausted quota must fail closed with a stable typed error and no partial state or unbounded retry
A killed writer must leave only a complete prior or complete new authoritative state after restart
Plaintext sentinels must never appear in metadata, backup files or provider-owned sealed bytes
